open_dashboard.description: Open the Coolify Cloud dashboard and report whether the session is authenticated (unauthenticated sessions are redirected to /login).

returns.description: { authenticated: boolean, url: string } — authenticated=false means the login page is showing; hand off to the user to log in once, the session persists in the profile.

list_applications.description: List every application on the Coolify instance with its deploy status — via the token API, no dashboard scraping.

instance.description: Named instance from ~/.config/coolify/config.json; defaults to the default instance.

returns.description: { count: number, applications: [{ uuid, name, fqdn, status }] }

app_status.description: Detailed status of one application, addressed by uuid or by (partial) name.

app.description: Application uuid, or a name substring that matches exactly one application.

instance.description: Named instance from ~/.config/coolify/config.json; defaults to the default instance.

returns.description: { uuid, name, status, fqdn, git_repository, git_branch, build_pack, updated_at } or { error, matches } when the name is ambiguous.

running_deployments.description: Deployments currently running or queued on the instance.

instance.description: Named instance from ~/.config/coolify/config.json; defaults to the default instance.

returns.description: { count: number, deployments: array } — empty when nothing is deploying.

list_servers.description: Fleet health at a glance: every server with reachability and usability flags.

instance.description: Named instance from ~/.config/coolify/config.json; defaults to the default instance.

returns.description: { count: number, servers: [{ uuid, name, ip, is_reachable, is_usable }] }
